title: An open workshop
description: Jamboree is an open access engineering club. You do not need experience, expensive tools, or a finished idea to take part.
body:
## Come as you are
Bring a question, explore an idea, or join a build. This wiki is readable without an account.

## Learn together
We share working notes, experiments, and mistakes so everyone has a place to start.

title: Go-cart pair
description: Two carts. One shared challenge: get from sketch to first drive.
body:
## The idea
Two carts. One shared challenge: get from sketch to first drive. This is a starter project note; scope and build details are still to be agreed.

## On the workbench
- Define the first useful prototype.
- Sketch the system and list the unknowns.
- Record components, decisions, and test results here.

## Build log
Add dated updates as the project develops.

## Photos and files
Upload a feature photo to `assets/uploads/`, then set `image` in this note’s frontmatter. Keep `featured: true` to show this project on the homepage.
